---
title: "A cell starts a process and leaves it running"
format: html
engine: julia
---

```{julia}
println("before the process starts")
# The process inherits the pipe the cell's output is captured through, and
# outlives the cell, so the capture cannot wait for that pipe to reach its end.
run(`$(Base.julia_cmd()) -e "sleep(90)"`; wait = false)
println("after the process starts")
```
